annotations.title: Brazil CNPJ Checker: Official Company Record by CNPJ Number

description: Look up a Brazilian company by its 14-digit CNPJ number (with or without dots, slash and dash): legal name, trade name, legal form, active or closed status, start date, address, CNAE industry code and size class, from the Receita Federal open data (served by BrasilAPI). Checks the CNPJ check digits first. Company-level only: no partners, no phones, no e-mail, no individual entrepreneurs (MEI). Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

cnpj.description: One CNPJ, for example 33.000.167/0001-01, 33000167000101 or an alphanumeric CNPJ such as 12.ABC.345/01DE-35.

cnpjs.description: Up to 100 CNPJ numbers in one run (Apify Actor only). Each CNPJ that finds an active registry record is one billable result.
